titles.native: おジャ魔女どれみ お笑い劇場

description: Ojamajo Doremi: Owarai Gekijou is an original net animation spin-off based on the Ojamajo Doremi series. This series consists of 26 short episodes that were uploaded fortnightly on Toei Animation's YouTube channel. This series features chibi versions of the character designs from the light novel series.
